items.text: sticker words on a phone: Text opens its box at once (in a moving sticker's share sheet too), and the keyboard stays while the sticker is made again around your typing
a walked path's tick on the tools shelf is the tiny tick in its small ring, not a big check over a dark disc
on a phone the dice shelf swipes all the way to the pair of dice, past the longest Fibonacci and prime counts
a scene's own crossfade (30 s) stays on one line, and a tapped button in the list no longer stays grey
every slider has the same round knob in the accent, on a thin track filled up to it (on an iPhone they were white pills)
on an iPhone in the light theme, the strip under the page is dark like the stage, not white

the light theme, panel by panel. Lit labels in the accent (WET, REACT, the selected beat, tabs, presets) are a deeper shade of it on light glass, so they read; the Pack tab is dark words on light; the share sheet stays a dark room with light words in either theme; the open tools button is tinted glass, not a dark disc
the path badges on the tools shelf are the same small dot as under the bar: one digit, a tiny tick once walked
in the mixer, Music is Track, as on the shelf
the keys sheet is full screen, like the share sheet: the whole page scrolls, the close stays at the top
hints at the top of the screen stay as long as it takes to read them (a long one went in about a second)
the keys sheet is compact again: its keys flow across as many columns as fit, so it shows whole on a laptop and never runs off the top of a large screen
